context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 86 validated Busy Slots feature end-to-end: (1) POST /api/users/me/busy-slots creates busy slot with validation (start/end required, end>start, valid ISO format). (2) GET /api/users/me/busy-slots lists user's slots. (3) DELETE /api/users/me/busy-slots/{slot_id} removes slot, returns 404 for unknown. (4) Idempotent upsert via source_id - same source_id updates existing slot. (5) GET /api/book/{username}/slots excludes times overlapping busy slots (tested: 14:00-15:00 busy → 14:00, 14:30 excluded). (6) After DELETE, slots become available again. (7) All endpoints return 401 without auth. (8) Frontend CalendarPage external event dialog works: click external event → dialog opens → 'Als blockiert markieren' creates busy slot → toast success → event shows blocked indicator. (9) Smoke regression: auth, meetings, schedule-polls, surveys, booking, caldav-config all working.

bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB insert_one() modifies the dict in-place by adding '_id' (ObjectId), which is not JSON serializable
bug_fixed.fix: Added slot.pop('_id', None) after insert_one() in /app/backend/services/busy_slots.py line 83
